name: doubler_zener
rationale: The previous SSHI design suffered from excessive ripple and slow settling due to the large output capacitor needed to buffer its high-energy bursts. The reference FBR design was smooth and fast-settling but lacked the voltage to meet vout_min on S2 and S4. A voltage doubler (Greinacher) is proposed here. It provides a voltage boost (roughly 2x the piezo voltage) to ensure vout_min is met, while avoiding the spiky current pulses of the SSHI. By using a smaller output capacitor (Cout), we can simultaneously satisfy the 'settled' (fast time constant for RL=1M Ohm) and 'startup' requirements, while the inherent smoothness of the doubler maintains low ripple. Corrected the Zener orientation to prevent forward-biasing the output.
